description: Verify CMS FY 2027 ICD-10-CM, all 79,258 ICD-10-PCS codes (with MS-DRG V44 Errata XW0U3CC/XW0U4CC), HCPCS Level II A-V, RxNorm CPC, and LOINC codes with bi-temporal DOS/discharge gates, Excludes1 checks, zero AMA CPT strings, and 3 scientific Discovery Portals. Trigger on ICD-10-CM/PCS codes, M72.2/E89.830/XW0U3CC, medical claim denials, MS-DRG V44, HCPCS, LOINC, RxNorm, or symptom-to-discovery questions.
